body_lead: Lucknow: The SAWiT (South Asian Women in Tech) Learnathon, organized by GUVI, an HCL Group company, in collaboration with the UP govt, has set a new Guinness World Records title for garnering highest attendance in online training in generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in 24 hours. The record was jointly created by 46,000 women from across India and abroad, who completed certification in Generative AI and Python domains in 24 hours starting at 12pm on Sep 21.
